Subject: Vanguard Sentry — Private deployment networking & install kickoff

Hi Alex / Priya / InfraOps team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the Private deployment. I'm Soojin on the Customer Success team and I'll be your lead during onboarding. I want to kick off coordination around VPC peering, private endpoints, and the on-prem package so we have a clear 2–3 week runway to initial validation.

High-level asks for the first pass:
- Confirm a 60–90 minute networking review (we usually include Redwood SE + your InfraOps + VPN/Network owner)
- Share your CIDR blocks and a short network inventory (subnets, NAT rules, egress IPs)
- Confirm if HSM/KMS will be used for key management and any firewall proxy egress constraints

Attachments: vanguard-mvp-network-checklist.pdf (checklist + template).

Suggested meeting slots:
- Thu 6/22 10:00–11:00 PT
- Fri 6/23 14:00–15:00 PT

Next steps from our side: Priyom will prepare the VPC peering template and an on-prem installation runbook so we can align on IP ranges and firewall rules.

If those slots don't work, tell me times that do and we'll adapt. Looking forward to getting this into staging quickly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin — thanks for the note.

Thu 6/22 10am PT works for us (I'll confirm with InfraOps). Quick answers up front:
- We'll be using our primary VPC in us-west-2. Current CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 (we have several customer-facing subnets within that).
- We do plan to bring our own KMS via AWS KMS (we use a key alias we can share in the meeting).
- We have an internal egress proxy but allow outbound TLS to common cloud services; I can bring our network diagram to the call.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood support a split-horizon DNS configuration for private endpoints?
2) What does the canary rollout look like for private deployments (we need to present this to our SRE lead).

I'll attach our current network inventory. We can also invite our SRE lead if helpful.

Thanks,

Subject: RE: Vanguard Sentry — Private deployment networking & install kickoff

Alex / Priya — thanks for the quick reply and the CIDR heads-up. I'm Priyom from Solutions Engineering; I'll drive the technical side of the kickoff and the install runbook.

Short answers to your asks, and a minimal checklist for the networking review:
- Split-horizon DNS: supported. We use private hosted zones and can configure records for the private endpoints so internal DNS resolves to the VPC endpoints. We'll want to verify search domains and conditional forwarders during the call.
- Canary rollout model: we recommend a traffic-cutover in three phases — smoke validation (single service), staged traffic (10–30% w/ blue/green), global cutover. We provide a rollback playbook and health-check probes; can sync on thresholds you require.

Networking review checklist (please bring these items or answers):
1) List of subnets to peer (public vs private) and exact CIDR ranges
2) VPC peering vs Transit Gateway preference (we support either; template attached)
3) Firewall / ACL rules that will need to permit the Redwood egress IPs (we'll provide a recommended set)
4) Certificate management — will you use your own CA or ACM?
5) VPN / direct connect details if you intend to use on-prem package behind a private endpoint

Attachments I'm attaching now: redwood-vpc-peering-template.yaml, onprem-install-guide-v1.docx. I also created a JIRA ticket INFRA-4321 for the networking review and will update with notes from the call.

Acceptance criteria for staging:
- VPC peering established and basic ping/tcp validation to private endpoint
- Health checks (token auth) succeed from Redwood's validation runner
- Canary traffic passes predefined SLA thresholds for latency and error rate

If you want, share a preferred account for temporary API keys and we'll pre-provision the staging endpoints ahead of the call.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199

Thanks Priyom — the checklist looks good. Quick clarifications / updates:
- We'll use Transit Gateway for scale and will attach the relevant route tables; I'll share the TGW attachment IDs on Monday.
- Certificates: we use ACM for cloud endpoints; for on-prem we use a private CA. We'll need guidance on certificate rotation with the Redwood agent.
- We can provision a temporary API key for staging; I'll send that to Priyom via the secure channel you specify.

Also attaching our signed SLA (docusign-sla.pdf). We want to confirm the latency SLOs you test against during canary. Please call out the exact probe endpoints and thresholds.

We should include SRE (Dev Patel) on the call — copying him on infra alias is fine.

Best,
Alex
